title: Bihar BPSC Additional Director Online Form 2026 – Re-Open
vacancyDetails: Additional Director posts under BPSC; online form re-opened for limited period
qualification: As per BPSC Additional Director advertisement
selectionProcess: As per BPSC advertisement (interview / scrutiny as applicable)
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational and experience certificates
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.bpsc.bih.nic.in
2. Open Additional Director Re-Open Apply Online
3. Fill/update application
4. Pay fee if required and submit before new last date
shortDescription: Bihar BPSC Additional Director Online Form 2026 re-opened. Apply at bpsc.bih.nic.in.
content:
BPSC has re-opened the online application window for Additional Director posts.

Interested eligible candidates should apply before the revised last date mentioned in the re-open notice.
